items.title: db-sync hardens uploads and downloads
items.summary: Uploads persist transaction identities and return canonical journal acks, graph writes and journal metadata commit atomically, and first downloads start from the snapshot without an extra pull.

items.title: Native views and queries match master
items.summary: Native view filtering and sorting now behave like master, reference-backed filter values and saved view settings survive, and worker queries handle nested tags and #uuid/#inst constants.

items.title: File-graph import keeps non-outline content
items.summary: Markdown and Org files without bullets, or with text before the first block, no longer import as empty pages; a property and tag sharing a name on one page also import correctly.

items.title: Copy and export keep image assets
items.summary: Image blocks now export with their asset reference in Markdown, HTML and OPML instead of just the caption.

items.title: Publishing keeps private pages private
items.summary: Blocks of a page marked private stay out of an all-pages-public export, and static export files copy without copyFile.

items.title: Unlinked references get more accurate
items.summary: Unlinked references ignore ref ids left by edited links and now match plain-text mentions of a page's aliases.

items.title: API and MCP return nested blocks
items.summary: get-page-data keeps nested children, so MCP getPage and the HTTP/JS APIs return the full block tree on DB graphs.

items.title: Editor and slash command polish
items.summary: Math blocks keep the formula alone when saved again, /code, /calc and /quote insert a new block on blocks with text, and the duplicate heading command is gone.

items.title: Views and properties stop crashing
items.summary: Cleared date placeholders sort safely, table cell popups no longer focus unmounted cells, untyped single-value properties show the select, and deleted reaction targets render.

items.title: CI and test reliability
items.summary: The native host and RTC adapter build in CI, zvec dylib copying is limited to macOS arm64, and tests clean up their redefinitions before the next one runs.

items.title: Sync confirms uploads with canonical acks
items.summary: Uploads are now confirmed from the server's canonical acknowledgement and applied locally instead of pulling back the echo; own echoes skip overlay replay and integers survive undo replay.

items.title: db-sync server hardening
items.summary: The node server honors DB_SYNC_ADMIN_TOKEN, port and log-level settings, failed async routes return 500, non-UUID graph ids are rejected, and UUIDs and Unicode graph names serialize correctly.

items.title: File-graph import keeps more content
items.summary: Namespaced tags no longer drop other or ancestor tags, text around embeds and multi-line math import, code-block properties are kept, and values stay text when a number would change them.

items.title: Export and block attribute fixes
items.summary: Tags before macros no longer break export, open-blocks only applies inside embeds, refs to missing blocks are kept, and DB graphs stop storing file-graph attributes like SCHEDULED or Org drawers.

items.title: Native OCaml UI host keeps maturing
items.summary: Typed prop binds and callbacks, scope-bound timers, component-owned layout and host capabilities replace older patterns; the host now runs on macOS and Linux with closer web styling.

items.title: API, MCP and PATs cover more cases
items.summary: The semantic API and personal access tokens support E2EE graphs, the API accepts URL values and stable block identities, and MCP rejects unsupported streams and closes request resources.

items.title: Lower worker memory and safer snapshots
items.summary: The DB worker retains less memory, query failures are isolated from page snapshots, property integers parse as int64, graph assets stay in the encoded directory, and encrypted journal replay keeps titles.

items.title: Table sorting and filters behave
items.summary: Missing sort values go last in query and grouped views, unchecked checkboxes sort correctly, and the does-not-contain filter is case-insensitive.

items.title: Search, editor and property polish
items.summary: Cmd+K prefers existing matches over page creation, Unicode previews render, Alt+Shift+Up/Down keeps the selection, clipboard works in Safari and Firefox, and number defaults and closed values set correctly.

items.title: Nightly web app and test site banner
items.summary: The nightly web app now deploys daily, and test.logseq.com shows a banner pointing real work to app.logseq.com.

items.title: Sync recovers stalled uploads
items.summary: Stalled uploads now recover without dropping local edits, pulls follow the server journal with a pending-ops overlay, and timestamp-only touches skip revalidation.

items.title: db-sync pending ops on a display connection
items.summary: Pending operations are projected onto a separate display conn instead of reverse/rebase, simplifying how unsynced edits are shown.

items.title: Graph-scoped personal access tokens for RTC
items.summary: RTC gains personal access tokens scoped to a single graph, and clj-e2e RTC tests now run against a local db-sync server.

items.title: Editor clicks and keys behave during saves and scrolls
items.summary: A click while the page scrolls edits the right block, Escape or Shift+Up/Down keeps the editor a click opened, and move up/down follows page order.

items.title: Virtual list and journals scrolling fixed
items.summary: Blank virt-list bodies, scroll gaps, and journals pagination are fixed; block selection also clears on route changes.

items.title: Faster startup and page loads
items.summary: Electron keeps compiled page scripts across app opens, and LRU caches start empty to speed up startup.

items.title: File-graph import keeps data intact
items.summary: Imported class and property entities stay distinct, asset links in property values convert, and class/property roots are skipped when moving pages to Library.

items.title: Dates and repeats respect local time
items.summary: Deadline and Scheduled repeats step in the local calendar, and createJournalPage date-only strings stay on the right day.

items.title: Native GPUI and macOS app experiments
items.summary: Work continues on the GPUI client (theme, typed-prop page layout, responsive caret) and a native SwiftUI macOS app on the OCaml/LUI stack.

items.title: Desktop packaging and new-graph fixes
items.summary: The embedding sidecar ships in desktop builds, a reload after creating a graph opens it, and a missing export.css is created on first edit.

items.title: Undo restores deleted pages, blocks, and schemas
items.summary: Deleted pages and blocks with inner refs come back intact, many-to-one undos no longer collapse, property schemas restore, and tag templates skip re-insert on redo.

items.title: UUID refs resolve in search and breadcrumbs
items.summary: Nested [[uuid]] titles render as page names in search, breadcrumbs, and page refs; missing entities stay broken links instead of failing the save.

items.title: Property pickers and config toggles stick
items.summary: Node property pickers show current selections, Hide-by-default and similar toggles persist, choice identities stay stable, and empty multi-value slots clear without throwing.

items.title: SPA HTML publishing no longer blanks
items.summary: Export public pages boots with content again after fixing worker startup and asset wiring in the published shell.

items.title: Desktop packaging and Windows installer
items.summary: Nightly desktop bundles include the embedding sidecar again, and electron-builder 26.17.0 stops the NSIS crash on Windows 11 24H2+.

items.title: Graph download survives bad assets
items.summary: A single failed asset download no longer aborts the whole graph download once the snapshot is already imported.

items.title: Settings recover from broken config.edn
items.summary: Missing or unparsable logseq/config.edn is recreated so settings toggles unlock again instead of staying stuck.

items.title: Flashcards, assets, and image actions
items.summary: Tags that extend Card count as flashcards, new assets land on #assets, and Electron Copy Image / Show in folder work again.

items.title: Moves keep descendants under ancestors
items.summary: Selecting an ancestor with descendants and dragging or Alt+Shift+Up no longer pulls grandchildren out of their parent.

items.title: Search, cmdk, and DB performance
items.summary: FTS lookups use rowid, cancelled search migrations stop early, Themes cmdk results stay populated, and WAL sync plus tree flush cut idle work.

items.title: Undo restores moves, deletes, tags, and properties
items.summary: Five undo bugs found by property-based testing now round-trip correctly, with regression coverage in the worker suite.

items.title: Safer paste of page refs and embeds
items.summary: Deduped pasted page refs that exploded into thousands of pages, bounded the batch-delete dialog, and fixed drag/paste of page embeds.

items.title: Editor composition and focus fixes
items.summary: Dead-key layouts no longer double characters, escape-editing clears only its own block, and the editor flushes before ref navigation.

items.title: Query builder and /query hardening
items.summary: Incomplete /query syntax no longer crashes the app; property chips show titles, custom status/priority appear in filters, and class defaults stay scoped.

items.title: Sync and checksum reliability
items.summary: Value replacements stay in one request, stale local checksums heal on graph open, and outliner insert identities survive sync replay.

items.title: Tag pages and views feel snappier
items.summary: Tag page bodies mount after the objects table paints, small class tables sort without a row-limit walk, and block render watches are indexed.

items.title: CLI markdown block upsert
items.summary: Upsert blocks accept Markdown via --blocks/--blocks-file, with clearer skill docs and healthier worker retirement during CLI runs.

items.title: Flashcards empty state and due count
items.summary: When no cards are due, practice-again is offered instead of the create-card empty state, and the due counter refreshes after rating.

items.title: Repeating dates and page updated-at
items.summary: Date repeats stay on the correct calendar day west of UTC, clearing datetimes drops stale journal refs, and page updated-at bumps on insert/move/delete.

items.title: Library moves and browser MCP
items.summary: Only normal pages move into Library with correct namespace roots, and Electron /mcp works from browser-based MCP clients.

items.title: Faster DB graph scans
items.summary: Cut several O(graph) paths in views, journals, refs, and startup revision checks so larger graphs stay responsive.

items.title: Snappier block editing
items.summary: Stopped re-rendering the editor box on every keystroke and sized the textarea with CSS field-sizing where supported.

items.title: More reliable DB worker
items.summary: Moved lock ownership to SQLite and keep the worker healthy across system sleep so graphs do not get stuck after idle.

items.title: Library and sidebar polish
items.summary: Hide library blocks, collapse nested pages more cleanly, and refresh favorites after drag-and-drop reorder.

items.title: Property paste and undo fixes
items.summary: Copy and paste text property values as blocks, restore property values after undo, and keep child page content on selection delete.

items.title: Query and table view fixes
items.summary: Fixed query result views and set-literal editing, restored property columns, and sped up DB table scrolling.

items.title: CLI and Windows build fixes
items.summary: Added force-remove page, username/password login, and fixed Windows vite/bundle and state-phase build issues.

items.title: Import and publishing fixes
items.summary: Convert markdown headings into DB heading metadata on import, and honor default home in HTML export.

items.title: Faster file-graph import
items.summary: Optimized the file graph import path and preserved mention timestamps, icons, and PDF annotations more reliably.

items.title: Page rename and delete edge cases
items.summary: Update linking page mirrors on rename, tag Recycle as Page so File→DB deletes work, and load breadcrumbs on demand.

items.title: Property and shortcut polish
items.summary: URL property editor UX, default Task status icons, shared default shortcuts when resetting, and Contents from the right-sidebar menu.
